sentences.japanese: 私は巴里滞在中、二三の画家諸君と識り合ひになり、ちよいちよいアトリエを訪ねるやうなこともあつたが、いつでもその仕事振り、生活振りに多大の興味を惹かれた。
sentences.english: When I was in Paris, I became acquainted with two or three painters, and I went to visit their atelier from time to time. I was always fascinated by their method of work and their way of life.

sentences.japanese: 私はある時、初めて識り合ひになつた画家に伴はれて、深夜そのアトリエにはひつたことがある。屋根裏の薄暗い部屋である。
sentences.english: One time, I went to the atelier of a painter I had just met in the middle of the night. It was a dark room in an attic.
